title: Async Job & Event Contract

job_id.description: Long-running work is addressed by an opaque job handle that rejects raw and non-job-shaped values.
job_id.claim_boundary: No job payload or provider-side job identifier is stored or returned by this local contract. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

progress.description: Reported progress is normalized into the closed 0..1 interval and never trusted outside it.
progress.claim_boundary: Progress is a local observation only; no live job scheduler reports real completion. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

cancel.description: Cancellation is denied unless an explicit reauthentication result is present.
cancel.claim_boundary: No remote job cancellation is performed locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

resume.description: Resume is denied unless an explicit reauthentication result is present.
resume.claim_boundary: No remote job resumption or replay is performed locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

durable_state.description: Only settled job states are durable; in-flight state is not persisted and must be re-derived after a restart.
durable_state.claim_boundary: Durability is modelled as a local snapshot shape, not a durable queue or storage engine. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

event_order.description: Events are accepted only in strictly increasing sequence order; replayed or stale events fail closed.
event_order.claim_boundary: Ordering is enforced per local job instance only; no distributed ordering guarantee is claimed. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

deduplication.description: Duplicate events are rejected by idempotency key so retries cannot double-apply progress.
deduplication.claim_boundary: Deduplication is in-memory for this local contract; no shared dedup store is claimed. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

claim_boundary: This is a local async job and event contract, not a durable queue or worker runtime.
No plaintext job payload, provider job identifier, or credential is stored or returned.
Live scheduling, distributed ordering, and external durability evidence remain deferred. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
